content.title: XO, Kitty season 3 release time by time zone on Netflix
content.text: Teen matchmaker Kitty SongCovey is back, and her story is about to get even bigger! XO, Kitty season 3 is finally arriving on Netflix, and fans are eagerly awaiting the next chapter in her life.After the events of season 2, Kitty is stepping into her final year at KISS. She's ready to tackle any unexpected challenges coming her way and, of course, the complicated world of teenage romance. With fresh faces joining her journey and familiar characters returning, this season promises more drama, laughs, and heartfelt moments than ever before.Fans of the hit teen series know that every episode of XO, Kitty is packed with charm and the kind of romantic tension that keeps viewers glued to the screen. From Kitty's ongoing adventures in love to her journey of self-discovery and growth, the third season is shaping up to be a pivotal chapter in her story. We're talking one that fans won't want to miss!With the premiere just around the corner, everyone is asking the same question. When exactly can we watch it? To make sure you don't miss a second of Kitty's latest adventures, we've broken down the official Netflix release time for audiences in the U.S. and across the globe. That way, no matter where you are, you can be ready the moment XO, Kitty season 3 drops!(L to R) Gia Kim as Yuri Han, Minyeong Choi as Dae Heon Kim, Joshua Hyunho Lee as Jin, Jocelyn Shelfo as Madison, Anna Cathcart as Kitty Song Covey, Sunny Oh as Mihee, Anthony Keyvan as Quincy 'Q' Shabazian, Sang Heon Lee as Min Ho Moon in episode 301 of XO, Kitty | Youngsol Park/NetflixWhen does XO, Kitty season 3 drop on Netflix?XO, Kitty season3 is officially hitting Netflix on Thursday, April 2, 2026. In the U.S., the season will go live at 12:00 a.m. PT, which is standard for most Netflix originals. This means West Coast fans can start streaming Kitty's senior-year adventures the moment the clock strikes midnight.For those on the East Coast, the show will be available at 3:00 a.m. ET, while viewers in the Central time zone can tune in at 2:00 a.m. CT. This season includes eight episodes, giving fans plenty of Kitty-filled drama, romance, and laughs to binge all at once.Yes, you read that right. Netflix decided not to split up the third season like it's been doing with many of its other shows. Instead, it decided to keep up its regular release pattern for this series. In other words, you can expect the complete third installment to drop on its release date. There will be no batches!Here's the XO, Kitty season 3 release time on Netflix, depending on where you live:Hawaii: 9:00 p.m. HST on Wednesday, April 1Alaska: 11:00 p.m. AKDT on Wednesday, April 1West Coast of the US: 12:00 a.m. PT on Thursday, April 2Mountain Time: 1:00 a.m. MT on Thursday, April 2Midwest of the US: 2:00 a.m. CT on Thursday, April 2East Coast of the US: 3:00 a.m. ET on Thursday, April 2Brazil: 4:00 a.m. BRT on Thursday, April 2England: 8:00 a.m. BST on Thursday, April 2France: 9:00 a.m. CEST on Thursday, April 2Germany: 9:00 a.m. CEST on Thursday, April 2Italy: 9:00 a.m. CEST on Thursday, April 2Spain: 9:00 a.m. CEST on Thursday, April 2South Africa: 9:00 a.m. SAST on Thursday, April 2Israel: 10:00 a.m. IDT on Thursday, April 2India: 12:30 p.m. IST on Thursday, April 2South Korea: 4:00 p.m. KST on Thursday, April 2Japan: 4:00 p.m. JST on Thursday, April 2Sydney, Australia: 6:00 p.m. AEDT on Thursday, April 2What to expect from XO, Kitty season 3As mentioned earlier, XO, Kitty season 3 will see Kitty and her friends take on their last year at KISS. Kitty is returning for her senior year with big goals, high expectations, and a carefully crafted "Senior Sunset list." But as fans of the series know, life rarely goes according to plan for Kitty. Between navigating friendships, new challenges, and unexpected twists, Kitty will face experiences that push her to grow, adapt, and discover who she truly is.Romance remains at the heart of season 3, with Kitty's relationship with Min Ho taking center stage. After the ups and downs of previous seasons, this installment explores whether the two can finally define their feelings and take their connection to the next level.But it's not just about romance. Kitty's friendships, family ties, and personal growth are equally important as she learns to balance expectations, relationships, and her own ambitions during this pivotal year. Fans are also in for a treat with the return of Lana Condor as Lara Jean, Kitty's older sister from the To All the Boys I've Loved Before universe. That said, XO, Kitty season 3 is not an installment you want to miss!XO, Kitty season 3 will be released on Netflix on April 2.This article was originally published on www.netflixlife.com as XO, Kitty season 3 release time by time zone on Netflix.
